evals.name: fresh_ai_os_onboarding_hybrid
evals.prompt: I want to build a personal AI OS from scratch to manage my consulting work, study goals, and daily life. How should I set this up?
evals.expected_output: Agent initiates discovery interview, audits target directory, gathers user information, dynamically suggests a tailored foldering structure (00_Inbox, 00_Outputs, 01_Personal, 02_Learning, 03_Projects, _System) with explicit rationale, enforces Pristine Root Zero, recommends Google Workspace MCP, confirms Anthropic skills suite, and embeds Cognitive Sparring and Visual Craft rules.
assertions: Conducts discovery interview inquiring about scope, domain, tools, and constraints
Dynamically suggests tailored folder architecture (00_Inbox, _System, numbered workstations) with clear rationale
Enforces Pristine Root Zero protocol and 00_Inbox auto-routing logic
Recommends Google Workspace MCP or relevant universal connectors
Confirms installation of all Anthropic skills from github.com/anthropics/skills.git
Enforces Cognitive Sparring Partner protocol (Zero Unearned Praise, Pre-Mortem Filter, 'So What?' Drilldown)
Enforces Strategic Simplicity Filter and Single Next Physical Action Rule (<= 15 min, binary outcome)

evals.name: work_focused_enterprise_onboarding
evals.prompt: I need an AI OS purely for my software engineering and client consulting practice. I don't want any personal life or hobby stuff in here. What folder structure and rules do you recommend?
evals.expected_output: Agent identifies Work-only scope, recommends the Work/Professional OS archetype (00_Inbox, Projects, Engagements, Operations, Knowledge, Outputs, _System), presents rationale, and enforces anti-sycophancy, Root Zero, and real constraint grounding.
assertions: Suggests professional folder structure (00_Inbox, Projects, Engagements/Clients, Operations, Knowledge, _System)
Explains why this structure isolates workpapers from personal noise while maintaining Pristine Root Zero
Enforces Cognitive Sparring, Strategic Simplicity Filter, and Single Next Physical Action Rule

evals.name: personal_life_os_onboarding
evals.prompt: I want an AI OS strictly for personal life: tracking my personal finances, gym workouts, reading notes, and dropzone inbox for audio memos. How should we organize it?
evals.expected_output: Agent identifies Personal Life scope, suggests Personal Life OS foldering (00_Inbox, Life, Finance, Health, Learnings, Hobbies, Outputs, _System), details 00_Inbox dropzone triage, and embeds Layered Memory (<200 lines) and anti-sycophancy rules.
assertions: Suggests personal folders (00_Inbox, Finance, Health, Life, Learnings, Hobbies, Outputs, _System)
Details 00_Inbox dropzone triage for voice notes and captures to achieve Inbox Zero
Enforces Jeff Su Layered Memory protocol (<200 lines living radar) and Pristine Root Zero

evals.name: existing_workspace_adaptation
evals.prompt: I already have some project folders and notes in my directory. Can you turn this into a compounding AI OS without breaking my stuff?
evals.expected_output: Agent scans existing folders first, maps them non-destructively to an appropriate archetype, introduces 00_Inbox intake gate, _System infrastructure, AGENTS.md single source of truth, and baseline Four-Cs health score.
assertions: Performs pre-flight scan of existing folders
Preserves existing files non-destructively without accidental overwrites
Maps existing folders cleanly into AI OS taxonomy under Pristine Root Zero
Deploys canonical AGENTS.md, living radar MEMORY.md, pointer files, and 7 compounding templates into _System/Templates/
